data.name: Dhiyaad
data.long_meaning: Dhiyaad is an Arabic name for boys and girls, which means 'prosperous' or 'wealthy'. It is derived from the word 'dhayy', which means 'to increase or prosper'. In Islamic tradition, Dhiyaad is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
